signature_moves: Before-after rename row: grey de-emphasised source filename to bright new name joined by a green transformation arrow, repeated down the list — the product promise rendered as one scannable unit; demonstrate-don't-describe for an AI tool
Two-accent brand system: electric indigo (identity/selection) + electric green (transformation/status) on cool near-black, consistent across UI, brand backdrop and icon
Mascot-anchored trust: glossy 3D robot with glowing green eyes on indigo-violet gradient — buys first-impression forgiveness for automated output
defects: Non-native selection grammar — saturated full-bleed indigo fill + white text instead of flat inset accent-tinted fill (native tell, excluded from mac canon)
Multicolor sidebar icons — iOS/web pattern instead of monochrome SF Symbols (native tell)
Accent not system-bound — hardcoded brand indigo plus a second green accent, neither bound to the user's system accent (native tell)
UI contrast (WCAG non-text) — hairline row dividers/borders read <3:1 on the dark ground; secondary grey filename ~4:1 marginally under text floor

aesthetic.direction: Playful/toy crossed with neo-grotesque-product dark — dark cool-neutral ramp with electric indigo+green accents (neo-grotesque product) softened by pill-everything and a 3D mascot (toy/consumer). A 'consumer-AI dark' idiom.
peers: Raycast (dark neutral + accent, but far more restrained/native)
consumer Electron utilities on Setapp-tier lists
CleanShot-class polish but pushed toward toy warmth
aesthetic.cluster_hint: consumer-AI-dark / friendly-utility (non-native, tracked separately from macOS clusters)

psychology: Von Restorff / signal-detection — one saturated selection and one green arrow per row make the new name the remembered, pre-attentively-found element
Demonstrate-don't-describe (description-experience gap) — before-after rows show the AI output rather than describing it, the right move where trust in results drives conversion
Aesthetic-Usability effect + Fogg prominence — glossy mascot and polished dark theme form a ~50ms first impression that buys forgiveness for an automated tool
Jakob's Law — real traffic lights + Mac-shaped sidebar shell meet platform expectations, lowering learning cost despite the web internals
Hierarchy via de-emphasis (Refactoring UI) — grey source filename vs bright new name is textbook label-value contrast
notes: Only two source files: a marketing composite cover (no standalone gallery shots) and the app icon. The app WINDOW inside the cover is the sole UI evidence and it bleeds off the composite's right edge, so content-area width and full toolbar are unknown; all tokens are single-render (estimated) at ~@2x. Lineage is web-electron (high) — this is CONTRAST EVIDENCE ONLY: none of it may feed macOS canon or native clusters; its non-native properties are recorded as tells with native corrections. The icon (3D robot mascot) was not digested (task scoped to Workflow A / UI only) but corroborates the indigo+green brand system. Corpus remains effectively 0 native apps after this digest — Zush cannot seed a macOS cluster. macapp.supply marketing copy ('for Mac and Windows', 'Private Offline AI') is context, not design evidence.
